steps.title: Gather required materials
steps.instruction: Collect all listed items with catalog numbers: Mini Petri dishes, 30 mm (Sigma‑Aldrich, SLW1480/12D); microsurgical scalpel, 22.5° straight (Sharpoint, 72‑2201); 50‑µl calibrated glass microcapillaries (Drummond, 2‑000‑050); aspirator tube assemblies for calibrated microcapillary mouth pipette (Sigma‑Aldrich, A5177‑5EA); 0.2 µm syringe filter (Pall Life Sciences, PN 4612); Epredia™ PTFE diagnostic slides, 3‑well (Thermo Fisher, 10632391) and 8‑well (Thermo Fisher, 10727951); C57BL/6J female mice, 3‑5 weeks old; PMSG (5 IU per injection, Sigma‑Aldrich, G4877); hCG (5 IU per injection, Sigma‑Aldrich, CG10); fibronectin solution (bovine, Sigma‑Aldrich, F1141‑2MG) or powder (human, 11051407001); M2 medium (Sigma‑Aldrich, M7167); mineral oil (Sigma‑Aldrich, M8410); PBS (Sigma‑Aldrich, P4417).

steps.title: Hyper‑stimulate females (optional)
steps.instruction: Inject each 22‑24 day‑old (up to 35 days) female intraperitoneally (i.p.) with 5 IU PMSG; after 48 h inject 5 IU hCG i.p.; schedule injections so that timed mating begins 12‑14 h after the hCG injection.

steps.title: Determine estrous stage (optional)
steps.instruction: If not hyper‑stimulating, assess the estrous cycle by vaginal smear cytology as described by Champlin et al. (1973) and Caligioni (2009).

steps.title: Introduce male for timed mating
steps.instruction: During the last dark hour of the 12 h dark cycle (30‑60 min), place a male mouse into the female’s cage under red light; avoid disrupting the light/dark cycle.

steps.title: Check for vaginal plugs
steps.instruction: At light onset (set as 1 h post‑coitus), examine females for vaginal plugs; retain plugged females for sperm collection at the desired post‑coital time (e.g., 3‑4 h or 7‑8 h). Non‑plugged females may be reused for another mating round.

steps.title: Example injection‑mating schedule (illustrative)
steps.instruction: In a 12‑h light/12‑h dark facility (lights on 7 am, off 7 pm): inject PMSG 6 pm Day 1; inject hCG 6 pm Day 3; start mating at 6 am Day 4 (12 h after hCG) under red light; allow mating for 2 h; check plugs at 7 am; sacrifice plugged females at 9:30‑10:30 am for 3‑4 h post‑coitus or at 4:30‑5:30 pm for 7‑8 h post‑coitus.

steps.title: Sacrifice plugged females
steps.instruction: Euthanize each plugged female by CO₂ asphyxiation or cervical dislocation at the chosen post‑coital time point.

steps.title: Dissect reproductive tract
steps.instruction: Under a well‑lit stereo microscope, grip the fat pad around the ovary, stretch gently to expose the membranous boundaries (ovary‑oviduct line 1, oviduct‑uterus line 2). Cut the membrane around the proximal oviduct, then around the bursa just outside the infundibulum, and finally cut the uterus just outside the uterotubal junction (UTJ).

steps.title: Place trimmed tract in M2 droplet
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire trimmed tract into a 0.3 ml droplet of M2 medium under mineral oil.

steps.title: Micro‑dissect tract regions
steps.instruction: Using a microsurgical scalpel, separate the tract into ampulla, middle isthmus (2‑3 mm segment), and UTJ.

steps.title: Release sperm into droplets
steps.instruction: Place each dissected region into an individual 100 µl droplet of M2 medium in a mini‑Petri dish under mineral oil; gently press the tissue to release sperm.

steps.title: Collect sperm by mouth aspiration
steps.instruction: Observe the droplets under a stereo microscope (optimally by three persons) for ~10 min; using a mouth‑pipette connected to a 50‑µl glass capillary and a 0.2 µm filter, aspirate individual sperm from each droplet.

steps.title: Enrich sperm preparation
steps.instruction: Transfer the aspirated liquid to a second droplet, avoiding larger somatic cells (epithelial cells, RBCs) and debris to obtain a sperm‑enriched preparation.

steps.title: Prepare fibronectin‑coated slides – Method A
steps.instruction: Spot 50‑100 µl of bovine‑plasma fibronectin solution directly onto the slide surface repeatedly to form a domed drop; after 2‑5 min (when the dome edge begins to dry), rinse the coating with water. Slides are ready immediately; no incubation required.

steps.title: Prepare fibronectin‑coated slides – Method B
steps.instruction: Reconstitute human‑plasma fibronectin powder in sterile water at 1 mg/ml by incubating 30 min at 37 °C; aliquot and store at –20 °C. Prepare a fresh working solution of 50 µg/ml in water. Apply 50 µl per well of a 3‑well slide or 10 µl per well of an 8‑well slide; incubate in a humid chamber for ~1 h; rinse with water and keep slides in the chamber until sperm deposition. Minimize time between coating and sperm addition.

steps.title: Deposit sperm onto 8‑well slides
steps.instruction: Place the collected sperm into a 10 µl PBS droplet on each well of a fibronectin‑coated 8‑well Teflon slide; aim for at least 10 sperm per sample. If excess tissue is transferred, perform a PBS wash step before deposition.

steps.title: Prepare material for 3‑well slides
steps.instruction: Further dissect remaining tissue, manually remove macroscopic pieces, mix the residual material with PBS at a 1:10 ratio, and smear ~30‑50 µl of this suspension onto each well of a fibronectin‑coated 3‑well Teflon slide.
